description: Public GAtrends radar for games and big tech. Returns the latest signals from the last 24 hours: spikes in Steam players, news coverage and Wikipedia views for the tracked topics, new topics found in headlines, trending Google searches, new Steam entries, Hacker News stories and new GitHub repositories, with the headlines and links behind each one. Use it to find what just became popular. Read-only, no account needed.

limit.description: How many signals to return (1-8). Default 8.

topic.description: Only signals mentioning this game or topic, for example GTA 6, CS2 or OpenAI.

name: get_trend_signals
title: Fresh trend signals
